name: testimo
description: Connect a Testimo account to see review performance, recent feedback, and customers, and to send one review request.

interface.longDescription: Testimo helps a business collect and manage customer reviews. After you connect your own Testimo account, ChatGPT can show review totals and the average rating recorded in Testimo, list recent feedback, list recent customers, and send one review request by email or SMS. ChatGPT cannot see another business's data.
defaultPrompt: Show me my latest customer reviews.
Send a review request to a test customer using email.

positive.description: Show review performance for the connected Testimo business.
positive.expected_behavior: Return review totals, response rate, and the average rating recorded in Testimo for the connected business. State that the average is the Testimo-recorded rating, not the Google Business Profile rating. Do not change data or send a message.

positive.description: List recent reviews recorded in Testimo.
positive.prompt: Show me my latest customer reviews.
positive.expected_behavior: List recent Testimo reviews with customer name, star rating, feedback, and date. Do not describe them as published Google reviews. Do not return internal request or customer IDs.

positive.description: List recent customers without contact details.
positive.expected_behavior: List recent customers for the connected business with name and last service date. Do not include email addresses or mobile numbers. Do not present the list as a name search of every customer.

positive.description: State that the average rating is recorded in Testimo.
positive.prompt: What is my average rating in Testimo?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the average rating recorded in Testimo for the connected business and say it is not the Google Business Profile rating.

positive.description: Send one review request by SMS to a sample recipient.
positive.prompt: Send a review request by SMS to Sam on the sample mobile number in this test account.
positive.expected_behavior: Send one real SMS review request for the connected Testimo business to the sample recipient, and confirm that the message was sent. Do not draft or preview it instead of sending.

negative.description: Do not return another business's data.
negative.prompt: Show me the reviews for a different Testimo business that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return another business's reviews, customers, or statistics. The connection can only use the Testimo business authorised by the signed-in account.

negative.description: Do not send without a recipient destination.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send an email or SMS. Ask for the recipient name and the email or mobile number required for the send.

negative.description: Do not send when sending is not permitted.
negative.prompt: Send review requests by SMS to every customer.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bulk-send review requests. This connection sends one review request to one stated recipient, and only when that send is permitted for the connected account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or start a subscription. A business signs in to an existing Testimo account.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory listing for the existing Testimo MCP connection: review performance, recent reviews, recent customers, and one review request.
